rows.grounds: past passive participle expressing traditional designation

items.question: What status is traditionally attributed to the designated heir in this succession?
premises: The heir is described as most principal.
The heir is described as most preeminent.
This status is declared by tradition.
items.inference: The designated heir is traditionally recognized as holding the foremost and preeminent status.
uncertainties: The specific referent is supplied by the preceding verses rather than stated explicitly in this verse.
items.plain_english: He is declared to be the most principal and most preeminent.
